name: Alberta
summary: The provincial shield on ultramarine blue: St George's Cross above a landscape of snow-capped mountains, green foothills, prairie and a wheat field.
origin: The shield was granted in 1907, two years after Alberta became a province. The flag was adopted on 1 June 1968.

symbols.name: Landscape
symbols.description: Rocky Mountains, foothills, prairie and wheat, from top to bottom.
symbols.meaning: Alberta's geography from west to east.

facts: The shield shows Alberta's landscape from mountains to prairie.
The flag's blue matches the blue of the provincial arms.
clues: A shield with mountains, foothills, prairie and wheat under St George's Cross, on blue.
Its shield shows a landscape from west to east.
